findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A Codex-trusted project starts a worker or cold read while Forge's project hooks await approval or have changed. Codex 0.169.0 serializes the new `environmentId` field, including when it is null, in [hook metadata](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.169.0/codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/plugin.rs#L540-L563). `src/forge/codex_turn.py:35` does not exclude that field, so the comparison at line 197 rejects Forge's own hooks and stops before starting the conversation. This leaves the stated criterion unmet: New repos default Codex build, fix and lite to gpt-6.2-sol, Forge drives Codex through SDK 0.169.0, Forge's own forge.toml uses gpt-6.2-sol, and reviews and cold reads stay on gpt-6.1-terra at max.

The changed skill states the fallback in reference text but does not tell the user during either command.
Adds work: announce the new default during upgrade or doctor; F 1 x H 2 = 2; 2 x C = 2

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - The pull-request smoke workflow runs with its configured API key. `.github/workflows/codex-smoke.yml:37` installs the newly pinned SDK, but line 43 still invokes Python from the `openai-codex-0.159.2` directory. A fresh runner has only the 0.169.0 directory, so login fails and the real SDK smoke test never runs.
findings.title: Gate: Codex SDK smoke test

findings.body:

Raise: Test
Case: normal use - CI exercises Forge's automatic trust of its own hooks. The stub now reports version 0.169.0, but its hook response at `tests/stubs/codex-app-server:106` omits that version's `environmentId` field. Consequently, `tests/test_codex_turns_trust_forge_hooks.py:95` and its reader case pass while the real SDK rejects those hooks. Update the edge fixture and command-level proof to cover the actual response.

why: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra on 17 Nov 2026, and Codex 0.169.0 lists gpt-6.2-sol. Forge's Codex build, fix and lite defaults still name gpt-6.1-sol, and Forge pins the Codex SDK at 0.159.2. Owner decisions: move the Codex default from gpt-6.1-sol to gpt-6.2-sol, move the Codex SDK pin to 0.169.0, keep reviews and cold reads on gpt-6.1-terra at max, and keep gpt-6-luna for Codex helpers. Existing client repos keep their model settings; they are told of the new default (no automatic model migration). Forge's own forge.toml moves to gpt-6.2-sol.
